title: Dark of the Woods / Soft Come the Dragons
author: Dean R. Koontz
note: conf=0.92; Verified: this is the 1970 Ace Double (Ace 13793) pairing the novel "Dark of the Woods" with the short-story collection "Soft Come the Dragons," both by Dean R. Koontz, bound dos-a-dos. The EPUB metadata's "Soft Comes the Dragons" is a common misrendering; ISFDB and dealer listings give the correct title as "Soft Come the Dragons." ISFDB catalogs the volume as an omnibus titled "Dark of the Woods / Soft Come the Dragons" (1970). No genuine fiction series: neither work belongs to a Koontz series, and "Ace Double" is a publisher format/numbered publication series, not a story series, so series is reported as null. Author name as published is Dean R. Koontz (later editions of Dark of the Woods appear as by Dean Koontz).
